benefits.name: Walmart+ fuel savings
benefits.instructions: Up to 10¢ a gallon at participating Walmart, Exxon, Mobil, Murphy and CITGO stations; claim it through the Walmart+ benefit at the pump (terms at walmart.com/plus). Less at Walmart and Murphy in some states.
benefits.source_excerpt: save 10¢ per gallon ... without raising the $98 annual membership price
